title: Engine Roster
description: Data contract between NbaApi (Python) and the C++ game engine. Produced by scraper.py, consumed by GameManager::LoadRosterJSON().

id.description: Unique player identifier (matches NBA player ID from nba_api)

team.description: Team abbreviation (e.g. 'LAL', 'GSW'). Optional — used for franchise synergy detection.

cost.description: Draft cost in gold units. Derived from salary cap percentage: >=25%=5, >=15%=4, >=8%=3, >=3%=2, <3%=1

shooting.description: Shooting ability. Derived from z-score of points per game: 50 + (z * 20), clamped [1, 99]

speed.description: Movement speed. Derived from z-score of speed metric: 50 + (z * 20), clamped [1, 99]

defense.description: Defensive ability. Derived from z-score of defensive win shares: 50 + (z * 20), clamped [1, 99]
